state:
Goal `core-xml-writer`: `Core\Xml\Writer::attribute`, `comment` and `cdata` have all their feature proofs, and their cards (`ATTRIBUTE_DOC`, `COMMENT_DOC`, `CDATA_DOC` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs`) are in plain words. `Core\Xml`, `Core\Xml\Node` and `Core\Xml\Reader` pass `bun nv proofs --verify` again: their perf records were re-measured after `xml.rs` moved.
Seven Writer members still owe examples, hostile, perf and a Rust test: `startDocument`, `endDocument`, `startElement`, `endElement`, `content`, `instruction`, `doctype`.
Gap `nvs-stdlib/an-xml-writer-holds-a-string-per-piece` still stands: keep writer attacks and benches under about 500,000 pieces, or mark them with that gap.
Any later edit to `xml.rs` code stales the whole `Core\Xml*` perf set again: finish with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Xml' --group 'Core\Xml\Node' --group 'Core\Xml\Reader' --group 'Core\Xml\Writer'`.
`Core\Xml\Node::text` returns `""` for an element (its text is in its text children), so an example reads `->children()[0]->text()`.
